body: CHIEF CONTENT HOLD — the CODE RED boundary changes two previously landable documentation candidates. Do not land cand-5T2Q65J8XRARDYYYPKP5FPB2AZ at b73692f or cand-6CW0BXWTDXFF4VKHXKAS49M3AP at a7fa64a. Their reviews and authorizations predate the construction-uncertainty finding. Exact source audit shows both bind a checked RecallGraph but neither binds segmentation/interpretation construction authority or retained-alternative identity; the visualization can therefore look publication-grade while remaining heuristic- and selection-conditioned. Narrow successors must add a policy/receipt plus selected-alternative identity, a same-content heuristic-vs-admitted falsifier, and, for sensitivity output, separate complete result families rather than averaged or concatenated P/F across segmentations absent a declared common base measure and calibration. The audit also found three source-description corrections in nomination and two in visualization. Successors are being prepared in isolation; this post does not authorize implementation vocabulary, landing, or a new ADR.
